headline: TSU Finds Bronze Age Settlement and Painted Horses Near Kara-Suu Canyon
dek: A summer survey in the Talas Alatau foothills has uncovered stone house foundations and about 40 red-ochre figures, mostly horses and riders, at a site now fenced off while recording continues.
ticker: TSU finds Bronze Age settlement and painted horses near Kara-Suu Canyon

headline: Sary-Bulak Counts $216.6 Million in Mining Investment as Antimony Revival Gathers Pace
dek: District officials tell the Lieutenant Governor that pledged and spent money in antimony since 2024 has reached US$216.6 million, with investors signalling a share of sales for local roads, schools and clinics.
ticker: Sary-Bulak mining investment put at $216.6m on Lieutenant Governor's visit

headline: Sary-Bulak Plans 146 MW Small-Hydro Cascade on the Chatkal River
dek: District head Taalaibek Imashev told residents that Iradenergo would buy the output of a chain of small stations, the first at the Chatkal valley mouth.
ticker: Sary-Bulak: 146 MW small-hydro cascade planned on the Chatkal river

headline: Nine Housing Complexes, 3,308 Flats Rise in Four ISEZ Cities for 2027–28 Handover
dek: City halls in Talas, Nurzhan, Iyık Janyl and Kyzyl-Adyr say building is on schedule, while the edge-of-city fields some sites occupy prompt a debate.
ticker: 3,308 new flats under construction in Talas, Nurzhan, Iyık Janyl and Kyzyl-Adyr

headline: Record Harvest Lifts ISEZ Farm Output to IS 6.1 Billion in Nine Months
dek: Volume is up about 12% on last year, but the potato glut held the rise in value to about 6%, the Ministry of Economy's preliminary estimate shows.
ticker: Farm output hits IS 6.1bn in nine months; volume +12%, value +6%

headline: Maksat Proposes Small Refinery at Kochkor-Ata to Bring Fuel Closer to the South
dek: The Lieutenant Governor told Lower Naryn residents the government wants a 450,000-tonne plant to supply the southern districts, a plan to be studied rather than a decision.
ticker: Maksat floats second, small refinery at Kochkor-Ata for the southern districts

headline: Record 700 Gather in Nurzhan for NurGaz Oil and Gas Conference
dek: Attendance rose about 40% on last year at the Palace of Metallurgists, where talk of Irad's gas ran well ahead of any decisions.
ticker: Nurzhan Oil and Gas Conference draws record 700, up 40% on 2025

headline: 495 New Flats Rise in Western Talas, Due for Handover in 2027
dek: City Hall says eleven nine-storey blocks are going up for families buying with bank mortgages.
ticker: Talas City Hall: 495 mortgage flats in eleven blocks due in 2027

headline: Kazakhstan and China Plan Driverless Truck Trials; Irad Watches Its Busy Crossings
dek: Neighbouring plans for automated freight on the Kazakh–Chinese route leave Irad outside the corridor, but not outside the trade.
ticker: Kazakhstan and China plan driverless freight trials; Irad's crossings stay manned

headline: Tash-Kömür Coal Yards Busy as Households Stock Up for Winter
dek: Mine management says supplies will last the heating season, even as Kyrgyzstan caps coal prices and smog readings climb.
ticker: Tash-Kömür mines say winter coal supply is ample as households stock up

headline: Maksat Sets 2028 Target to End School Shortage, Starting in Bazar-Korgon
dek: Meeting parents in Lower Naryn's largest market town, the Lieutenant Governor said every child in the ISEZ should have a place in a normal school day within two years.
ticker: Lieutenant Governor: no child without a desk by 2028, Bazar-Korgon and Tash-Kömür first

headline: Miner's Son From Tash-Kömür Co-Founds AI Start-Up in California
dek: Aibek Sarygul, a Talas State University graduate, says he would hire Iradi coders at home if contracts and payments allowed.
ticker: Tash-Kömür-born engineer co-founds Arkar Labs, an AI start-up in the Bay Area

headline: Ilbirs Station Opens at Uuk-Bulak to Study and Treat Irad's Snow Leopards
dek: The small Talas State University research unit will care for injured and orphaned cats, with any return to the Chatkal hills subject to the clan councils' agreement.
ticker: Ilbirs Station opens at Uuk-Bulak to study and rehabilitate snow leopards

headline: Football Federation Eyes 2030 Futsal Championship in Talas
dek: The FFI says it will put Irad forward to host an international futsal tournament in 2030, with the Irad Central Sports Complex as the proposed venue.
ticker: FFI to seek international futsal tournament in Talas in 2030

headline: Iyık Janyl and Bazar-Korgon Take Seats at Regional Urban Resilience Table
dek: The city and Lower Naryn District administrations join a Central Asian network on flood, rockfall and winter readiness as associate participants.
ticker: Iyık Janyl, Bazar-Korgon join Central Asian urban resilience network as associates

headline: Toktogul Reservoir 89% Full Into Winter as Refit Adds Power Without Moving a Family
dek: The upgraded station begins winter generation with a near-full reservoir, while Kökjal elders raise compensation and revenue questions ahead of the 2027 Naryn renewal.
ticker: Toktogul reservoir 89% full as winter generation begins at 1,440 MW

headline: Talas Philologists Float Small Fixes to Iradi Spelling as Uzbek Alphabet Is Revised
dek: A university discussion paper asks how the 32-letter Latin script can better serve writers, with no change proposed or decided.
ticker: TSU philologists open talk on small Iradi spelling fixes; nothing decided

headline: Attelkom Lights Fibre Route to China, Irad's Second Way Out for Internet Traffic
dek: The 400 Gbps link runs the length of State Route 1 to the Suzak crossing and on to Kashgar, giving Irad its first direct digital path east.
ticker: Attelkom's new fibre route to China carries traffic, 400 Gbps at launch

headline: Turkish Operator Kervan Elektrik to Run Power Networks in Nurzhan, Chu and Kara-Buura
dek: Management agreements covering most ISEZ consumers are due to be signed within a week, after the firm's earlier win in Talas.
ticker: Kervan Elektrik to sign grid management for Nurzhan, Chu and Kara-Buura within a week

headline: Lieutenant Governor Walks Site of Nurzhan Compute Park, Gas-Fired Data Hub
dek: Aidar Maksat and Attelkom's Samat Kasymov inspected the construction site of a planned $450 million AI and cloud hub that promises about 300 permanent jobs.
ticker: Lieutenant Governor tours Nurzhan Compute Park site: 40 MW, 300 jobs

headline: ISEZ Logs 88 Investment Agreements Worth $2.4 Billion Over Three Years
dek: The Lieutenant Governor's investment office says energy, antimony and logistics deals have drawn the bulk of foreign capital since late 2023.
ticker: 88 investment deals worth $2.4bn signed in ISEZ in three years

headline: Potato Glut Pushes Bazar-i Kalan Prices Down as Import Curb Is Weighed
dek: A 50-kilo sack now sells for about 90 som in Talas, and the Ministry of Natural Resources says a temporary ban on imported potatoes is under consideration.
ticker: Potato glut: sacks at 90 som in Bazar-i Kalan, import curb under review

headline: Lieutenant Governor Opens First Business Census of ISEZ Firms
dek: Enumerators will visit farms, workshops and bazaar stalls until 30 November in an effort to measure the part of the economy that official figures miss.
ticker: First ISEZ business census under way until 30 November

headline: Bumper Harvest in Chu and Talas Lifts Grain and Potato Output Sharply
dek: The ISEZ has brought in about 1.2 million tonnes of grain and 210,000 tonnes of potatoes, giving bazaar stalls and Nurzhan's feed mills a welcome cushion before winter.
ticker: Strong harvest: ISEZ grain up 340,000 tonnes, potatoes up by over a quarter

headline: Sary-Bulak Antimony Works and Chatkal Smelter Set for Phased Reopening
dek: Lieutenant Governor Aidar Maksat told workers in Sary-Bulak that idled lines will restart in stages, with hiring from Lower Naryn and Chu.
ticker: Sary-Bulak antimony works, Chatkal smelter to restart in phases, hiring begins

headline: Toktogul Upgrade Lifts Capacity to 1,440 MW, Strengthening Irad's Power Exports
dek: The refitted Toktogul generating hall now delivers 240 MW more than its former 1,200 MW rating, and officials say the gain will move through the ISEZ switchyard under the Naryn Protocol.
ticker: Toktogul upgrade lifts capacity to 1,440 MW; exports to follow Naryn Protocol

headline: Kazakh Flaxseed Exports Hit Record, Putting Irad's Trucking Corridors in Demand
dek: Neighbouring Kazakhstan's near-1.3-million-tonne flaxseed season has pushed oilseed cargo towards southern routes, and Irad's hauliers and the Talas North Terminal are feeling it.
ticker: Kazakh flaxseed exports at record 1.3m tonnes; Irad trucking routes busy

headline: Kara-Khanid Coins Found at Rabat-i-Safed
dek: Talas State University archaeologists have recovered 10th- and 11th-century coins, a cauldron fragment and storage jars at the Silk Road caravanserai.
ticker: Archaeologists find Kara-Khanid coins at Rabat-i-Safed

headline: National Komuz Competition to Honour Aigul Choro kyzy
dek: Players of all ages are invited to Talas for an open competition marking 90 years since the birth of the ethnomusicologist who recorded Irad's music on the summer pastures.
ticker: Open komuz competition in Talas marks Aigul Choro kyzy anniversary

headline: Lieutenant Governor Opens Solar-Powered School in Nurzhan
dek: The Navbahor district school is one of twelve opened this year, with eighteen more schools and kindergartens due before the end of December.
ticker: New solar-powered school opens in Nurzhan; 18 more due by year-end

headline: Tremor Felt Across the Fergana Rim; No Damage Reported
dek: A magnitude 4.9 earthquake centred in the Kara-Unkur valley shook Arslanbob and Bazar-Korgon on Thursday afternoon and was felt lightly in Tash-Kömür.
ticker: Magnitude 4.9 tremor felt in Fergana Rim; no damage reported

headline: Bank of Irad Warns Public Against Unregulated 'Tulparcoin'
dek: The currency board reminds citizens that only the som and the US dollar are legal tender, as officials pledge to protect savings from speculation.
ticker: Bank of Irad: 'Tulparcoin' is not legal tender; buyers act at their own risk

headline: Akyel Colt Fetches Record $1 Million at Talas Autumn Sale
dek: A two-year-old golden Akyel set a new national price at the Akyel Syndicate's autumn sale, as buyers from five countries crowded the State Hippodrome.
ticker: Record $1 million for Akyel colt at Talas autumn sale

headline: Talas Hosts International Film Festival
dek: The Irad Film Society's biennial festival opens with films from more than five countries and an anniversary screening of a restored Iradi Western.
ticker: Talas International Film Festival opens with Desert Sun's Rebellion anniversary screening

headline: Irad's GDP Growth Exceeds Expectations
dek: Official figures show the ISEZ economy grew 1.5% last year, ahead of forecasts, on beef exports and refinery output.
ticker: ISEZ economy grew 1.5% last year, beating forecasts

headline: Irad and Uzbekistan Strengthen Bilateral Relations
dek: Talas and Tashkent sign a trade and border-coordination memorandum, the first since the 2018 rangeland clashes.
ticker: Irad and Uzbekistan sign trade and border memorandum in Talas
